automaticRules.evidence: config/providers.json documents :free on data[].id at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models; https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/routing/model-variants/free documents appending :free to a model ID. Remove only this terminal catalogue-tier suffix for checkpoint identity and preserve the complete author/checkpoint slug. Match only a trusted exact checkpoint; do not strip other variants or infer aliases. Free entries have independent pricing, context limits and endpoints; this rule transfers neither their metadata nor verified endpoint performance.

config/providers.json documents :free on data[].id at https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/models; the captured catalogue preserves full author/model IDs such as google/gemma-4-31b-it:free and poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free. https://docs.cline.bot/llms-full.txt documents provider/model-name IDs using OpenRouter's naming convention. Remove only terminal :free and require an exact trusted checkpoint slug; no stealth, family, date, precision or alias transformation, and no endpoint-performance claim.

config/providers.json identifies https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway/models as the catalogue and isFree as its free-tier selector. The captured catalogue explicitly lists author/model:free IDs, including stepfun/step-3.7-flash:free and nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free. Remove only terminal :free from those IDs and preserve the entire namespace/checkpoint; require an exact trusted checkpoint slug. This does not infer identity from isFree, canonical_slug, display names or non-suffixed routes, and does not verify endpoint performance.

config/providers.json identifies https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models as NVIDIA's catalogue; captured literal IDs include google/gemma-4-31b-it and openai/gpt-oss-20b. Preserve the complete published author/checkpoint ID unchanged and require an exact trusted canonical/Hugging Face checkpoint slug. NVIDIA namespaces are not universally Hugging Face namespaces: do not translate meta to meta-llama, add precision, resolve aliases or strip dates. Endpoint serving configuration/performance remains unverified.

config/providers.json identifies https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models as Groq's catalogue; captured openai/gpt-oss-20b and openai/gpt-oss-120b IDs exactly equal their hugging_face_id fields. https://console.groq.com/docs/models publishes these full namespaced IDs. Preserve each full ID unchanged and require an exact trusted canonical/Hugging Face checkpoint slug; do not expand short IDs such as allam-2-7b, rewrite publisher namespaces, or infer family/precision/alias equivalence. This is checkpoint identity only, not endpoint-performance parity.
